featuredArticle.title: How to apply a Drupal patch: A Step by Step Guide
featuredArticle.description: Applying a patch in Drupal is a common task for fixing bugs, introducing custom modifications, or testing updates before they are officially released. Patches are text files containing code changes, usually created using Git, that developers can apply to their local or remote Drupal environments. In this guide, we'll walk you through the step-by-step process of applying a patch, ensuring that you can confidently integrate changes while maintaining a smooth workflow.
